title: moss.intervention_completed (v1)
description: MOSS has finished its intervention and frozen a MossDecision into the Research Store (see agents/moss_agent/data-contracts/moss_decision.schema.yaml). MOSS Step 1 -- this is the frozen contract only; no consumer wired yet.

reason.description: Echo of (or MOSS's restatement of) why the intervention happened.

action.description: The action MOSS decided to take (free string; the code-level ActionGuard is the real enforcement, so this is intentionally not constrained by an enum).

moss_intervention_ref.description: Opaque ref into the Research Store resolving to the frozen MossDecision object.

degraded.description: Whether MOSS operated in a degraded mode (e.g. fallback heuristic instead of full LLM reasoning).
